title: IVG Pro 12 Blue Sour Raspberry Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Blue Sour Raspberry IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods offer a sharp, tangy twist on classic berry flavour. A hit of Blue Raspberry delivers a sweet and fruity base, lifted by a subtle sour edge that brightens the profile. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 0mg, 10mg or 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, along with a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once clicked into place, the refill system automatically supplies the pod as you vape — removing the need for coil changes or messy top-ups. Together, the components can support up to 10,000 puffs per kit, depending on your vaping style. The mesh coil delivers consistently smooth vapour with strong flavour payoff throughout. These pods are designed exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
